summary: Implemented `v2-cycle-05-uncertainty-result-set`. Serialized match payloads now always include `candidate_set`, derived only from `MatchResult.selected`; each public entry exposes only `name`, `article`, `confidence`, and `reason`. Existing `query`, `status`, `score`, and `ld_product` semantics are preserved, with non-match/failure results returning an empty candidate set.
mechanism_evidence: Public selected projection contains only name, article, confidence, and reason, excluding debug-only fields such as ld_id, scores, dimensions, and URLs.
candidate_set is populated from MatchResult.selected in order, not from raw retrieved candidates.
Multi-selection MATCHED test verifies candidate_set order, per-item confidence/reason, and candidate_set[0] equality with ld_product.
Single-selection MATCHED test verifies one-entry candidate_set and preserved legacy top-level fields.
NOT_FOUND and RERANK_FAILED tests verify empty candidate_set, null ld_product, and no promotion of retrieved candidates.
include_debug=False regression verifies candidate_set remains present while debug is absent.
OpenSpec apply status reports 7/7 tasks complete.
